title: FW↔QA-001: HIL Test Builds + Defect Reports
description: Firmware provides testable builds, unit tests, debug hooks/instrumentation, and defect fixes; QA provides HIL test results, integration/regression defect reports, end-to-end findings, and coverage reports. Grounded in FIRMWARE_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.5 and QA_TEST_AUTOMATION_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.1.

testable_build.description: FW→QA: a build instrumented for HIL/integration testing.

defect_report.description: QA→FW: defect with traceability back to requirements.

requirement_ref.description: Traceability to the requirement/NFR under test.

measured_value.description: Measured value for an NFR failure (with implied unit in description).

defect_fix.description: FW→QA: a fix with root-cause notes for re-verification.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine test-build/defect exchange (agent-autonomous). Release-gate defect closure feeds the QA go/no-go, which is a permanent Tier-1 HITL gate.
x-macp.cadence: CONTINUOUS (during development); TRIGGER (HIL/end-to-end validation in execution; release-gate defect closure)
confirm_conditions: TESTABLE_BUILD: unit_tests_passing = true and debug_hooks_enabled = true with a valid build_sha
DEFECT_REPORT: severity/test_type valid, requirement_ref present, reproduction_steps ≥ 20 chars
DEFECT_FIX: references an existing defect_id with root-cause notes and a fixed_in_version
reject_conditions: build delivered with failing unit tests or no debug hooks
defect report lacking reproduction steps or requirement traceability
counter_conditions: defect not reproducible on the supplied build — request environment/build clarification
severity disputed between FW and QA — negotiate within the rubric before closure
